unique_issues.title: Clarify A-series envelope labels and sizing context

evidence.quote: select a 4 x 6 inches card to pair ideally with an A4 envelope

unique_issues.reason: An American A4 envelope commonly accommodates a 4×6-inch card; the published pairing is not proven wrong. Different A-series conventions (US envelopes versus international paper formats) warrant clarification.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Explain the US A4 envelope dimensions when discussing 4×6 card fit. Do not identify this as an incorrect pairing without evidence.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Folded cards described as generally having pockets

unique_issues.reason: An interior pocket is a feature of some designs, not folded invitations as a general category.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Qualify as optional pocket-equipped folded formats.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

topic_search_intent.rationale: Core list of types present, initial explanation verbose.

factual_technical_accuracy.rationale: No demonstrated 4×6/A4 fit error; other broad claims and type distinctions need qualification.

semantic_information_value.rationale: Useful taxonomy but RSVP enclosure mixed with formats.

practical_decision_support.rationale: Tables help basic selection; missing detailed specs and realistic production instructions.

content_structure_readability.rationale: Organized list and tables; verbose opening and repetitive tone.

editorial_quality.rationale: Clear grammar and awkward heading errors.

executive_summary.strengths: Presents a useful invitation format taxonomy, event-based examples, a size table and selection considerations for paper, finish, budget and postage.
executive_summary.critical_findings: Incorrect grammar in main heading; Envelope size pairing likely incorrect; Folded cards described as generally having pockets; RSVP card conflated with invitation format; Unsupported popularity claim.
executive_summary.recommended_corrections: Use Why Do Invitation Cards Matter?; Verify envelope manufacturer specifications and clarify A4 envelope versus A4 paper sizing.; Qualify as optional pocket-equipped folded formats.; Separate main invitation formats from inserts and response cards.; Remove superlative or support with reliable market evidence..

source_verification.visual_exhibits: annotated published-text excerpts, NOT captured website screenshots

caveats: Wording, contradictions and structural issues were checked against published article text; some industry claims require authoritative vendor-specific validation.
